rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an animal's paw, especially when referring to dogs, cats, or other clawed animals.

example.english: The dog's paw got caught in the door.
example.traditional: 隻狗隻腳爪畀門夾親喇。
example.jyutping: zek3 gau2 zek3 goek3 zaau2 bei2 mun4 gaap3 can1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the humorous or mildly contemptuous human-hand sense, as in telling someone to take their dirty hands off something.

example.english: Keep your paw off my stuff.
example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 sau2 m4 hou2 dim3 ngo5 di1 je5
